# Goals and constraints

## Product goal

Night-shift nurses swap shifts in minutes without calling the ward manager.

## Quality goals

| id | goal | weight | why | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| QG1 | Availability at night | 30 | Swaps happen at night | STATED |
| QG2 | Privacy of staff data | 25 | Rosters hold personal data | STATED |
| QG3 | Fast response on phones | 15 | Nurses use phones on breaks | ASSUMPTION |

## Hard constraints

- HC-1: Data stays in the EU.

## Soft constraints

- Prefer managed services.

## Not in scope

- Payroll.

## Planning assumptions

- AS-1: two developers [ASSUMPTION: the team has two developers for the MVP]

## Open questions

- Which roster export exists? Default: CSV.
